newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-FAI Cup second round fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-FAI Cup second round fixtures.

text.p: This weekend's Football Association of Ireland (FAI) senior challenge cup second round fixtures. All kick-off times are given in GMT.
Bohemians vs Wayside Celtic at Dalymount Park, 1930 GMT.
Waterford United vs Shamrock Rovers at Waterford Regional Sports Centre, 1945 GMT.

Cork City vs St.Francis at Turners Cross, 1345 GMT.
